identityProtocol: SHA-256 of the probe files the measured runs execute (the module import closure of the baseline, transport preload and observation extension, plus the Go peer and TLS helper build inputs; test files excluded), selected-package files, production dependency trees, generated compaction/native footer inputs and PiG/Node/Go executable identities; not just the orchestration file.

package.measurementClass: Normal-optimization, non-profiling package measurements retained for final native comparison
package.protocol: Cold disposable PiG root per sample with shared build cache; selected package only (no observation extension or inspector); loopback transport preload; RPC get_commands readiness; one /usage current-provider refresh with its menu cancelled; aggregate host/descendant RSS; stdin EOF shutdown and all observed PIDs gone. No model prompt. loadAverage is the host's 1/5/15-minute load at launch.

instrumented.measurementClass: Normal-optimization inspector-instrumented observation-run measurements; not comparable with package samples
instrumented.protocol: Cold disposable PiG root with shared build cache; complete package plus identical probe; RPC get_commands readiness; aggregate host/descendant RSS after fixture run; stdin EOF shutdown and all observed PIDs gone. Includes synthetic Codex model prompts answered by the loopback proxy endpoint.
